name: caseus
description: Work in Caseus property management from Claude: tenants and arrears, supplier invoices and attest, fault reports, tasks and property reports. Connects to your own Caseus instance.

caseus_mcp_url.title: Caseus connection address
caseus_mcp_url.description: Copy it from your Caseus under Inställningar > Auktoriserade agenter. It starts with https:// and your own Caseus host, for example https://yourcompany.caseus.se/api/mcp
